text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Renault Portuguesa is to complain to Brussels against Portugal for alleged violation of competition rules. It says the state is favouring the Ford-Volkswagen Autoeuropa venture.
- Portugal's petrol company Petrogal contracted two international consultants, Mckinsey and Monitor, to assess its reestructuring plan, Plano Petrogal 2000.
- Poll shows majority think that opposition Social Democrat leader Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa is only a stop-gap solution.
- Wine company Sogrape doubled its offer to buy Quinta da Aveleda but Aveleda's shareholders refused the offer.
- French tobacco company Seita says its offer to buy Portugal's tobacco company Tabaqueira at its privatisation is as good as its two rivals.
- Sixty-nine percent of Portuguese would support the introduction of life sentences for serious crime. The maximum sentence in Portugal is 25 years.
- From 1998 onwards Portuguese textiles will be subjected to international competition.
